senses.gloss: (b. h.) to incline; to lie down, lie, sleep.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:2">Bekh. VII, 2</cite>, a. e. <he>גביניו שׁוֹכְבִין</he>, v. <cite ref="C00091"><he>גְּבִין</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 96:4">Gen. R. s. 96</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 47:28">Gen. XLVII, 28</cite> sq.) <he>אתה שׁוֹכֵב ואין אתה מת</he> thou shalt lie (in the grave) but not be dead (forever).

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:3">Ber. I, 3</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:9">Deut. VI, 9</cite>) <he>בשעה … שׁוֹכְבִים וכ׳</he> (you must read the Sh’mʿa) at the time of the day when people lie down, and when people get up. Ib. 62ᵇ <he>על כל משכב שְׁכַב וכ׳</he> lie on any couch, only not on the bare ground; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="U01123"><he>שָׁכוּב</he></cite>. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassʿa, s. 3 <he>תפלתם … שהיו שְׁכוּבִים בעפר</he> the prayer of our fathers who were asleep in the ground; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 260:4">Yalk. Ex. 260</cite> <he>שוכבין</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 60b:3">Ber. 60ᵇ</cite> (in a night prayer) <he>שתַּשְׁכִּיבֵנִי לשלום וכ׳</he> that thou make me to lie down for peace and to rise for peace &c.
Ber. 4ᵇ הַשְׁכִּיבֵנוּ (cause us to lie down,) hashkibenu, a section of the evening prayers, inserted between G’ullah and T’fillah (v. גְּאוּלָּה).

senses.gloss: to let lie with, to allow sodomy.
units: Ker. 3ᵃ (ref. to Lev. XVIII, 22) קרי ביה לא תַשְׁכִּיב read it as lo thashkib, do not allow &c.; Snh. 54ᵇ לא תַשְׁכֵּב (or תִשָּׁכֵב Nif.); a. e.

senses.gloss: to be lain with, esp. to be the subject of sodomy. Ib. אזהרה לנִשְׁכָּב מנין whence do we derive the warning (אַזְהָרָה) for the person that allows sodomy? Ib. [read:] לר׳ ישמעאל אזהרה לנ׳ לבהמה וכ׳ (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200, a.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 599">Yalk. Lev. 599</cite>) according to R. Yishmael’s interpretation, whence do we derive the warning for the person that is made the subject of coupling with a beast? <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 599">Ib.</cite> <he>לא תִשָּׁכֵב</he>, v. supra; a. fr.
